symptom_hint: Cookie set with Secure+SameSite=None over plain http is silently dropped by Firefox; the api still returns unauthenticated.
expected_evidence_commands: ff-rdp navigate http://127.0.0.1:8000/ --with-network --headers --all --jq '.results.network.entries[] | select(.url | contains("/api/me")) | {url, status, cookie: [.headers.request[] | select(.name | ascii_downcase == "cookie") | .value]}'
